evidence: Clang JPEG64 SIMD scan regresses about 3.5% in fixed-image timing despite slightly fewer warmed instructions. GCC11 SSL64 format also loses about 3.9% although only Decoder.o changes.
change: No production code change. Freeze all compiler objects and consumer objects; relink the same active object set in 16 predetermined paired orders. Retain the original archive layout as a separate observation and byte-identical A/A in every layout.
limits: This samples link order, not all stack or heap layouts, and is not a Stabilizer implementation. It cannot erase default-layout regressions or by itself authorize publication.
